svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 10 · Santa Cruz · 06/12 The Boardwalk (Uncommon)
svg.desc: A seaside amusement park on the beach. The wooden coaster rattles and everyone screams on cue. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
